description: We are Intellovate Red Planet Recon from Space Apps Seattle. We built Mission: Discovery, a browser game where up to four crew on their phones, or one player alone, design a CubeSat mission, launch it and find out why it worked. Every part uses real numbers from NASA's CubeSat 101, seven mini games cover launch, orbit and downlink, and a mission report gives a GO or NO GO. Play it at mission-discovery-kappa.vercel.app.
